accepts.because: redraw against a fresh picture of the colony NOW, rather than at the next tick; the hive ticks on its own, this is the extra one

emits.because: something a person did in the browser that is not a move -- a move is written inside the display and never becomes a message at all. Nothing inside this hive consumes it, and that is the honest state (2) of GH #284: a browser event nobody wired for is `no_route` in the dead-letter queue, recorded and self-localising, rather than silently swallowed. A parent that wants one drains it

description.purpose: One interactive canvas of the colony, served on a port of its own. A timer takes a topology snapshot, a code cell turns it into objects, and a display cell holds them and serves the page. The first -- and so far only -- thing it draws is the colony itself. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS: `params.ports` is empty, so no edge reaches a cell in here; a caller names the hive and a lane on `hop.route`.
description.use_when: An operator or a user should see and rearrange something the colony knows, in a browser, without an operator UI release for every new kind of object. Nothing has to point at it -- the way in is the HTTP port the display owns, and a reverse proxy in front of it is the whole access story.
description.not_in_scope: It draws nothing the topology snapshot does not hold, and it takes that snapshot on a timer through this hive's own lane to the colony's read-only graph endpoint (GH #163: that endpoint is one of the absolute endpoints a mutation may draw, because it is the sanctioned alternative to reading `colony.db`; the counts-never-content ledger endpoint joined it with GH #267). So the canvas is as fresh as that timer. No authentication and no TLS -- the display binds loopback by default and everything in front of it is somebody else's job (R-W8-2). No object library beyond cells, hives and edges. No stored camera: where a person is looking is theirs and stays in their browser.
description.contract_in: One lane, at the hive path. in_refresh -- take the topology snapshot now instead of at the next tick. Which cell does the asking is this hive's business.
description.contract_out: One lane, out of the hive path. event -- something a person did in the browser that this hive does not handle itself. Nothing inside consumes it, so a parent that has no use for it will see it dead-letter, which is the visible version of no consumer.
